name: Gobi Musallam
ingredients: ½ tsp each chilli powder, garam masala and turmeric
½ cup cooked chickpeas, mashed into the gravy
steps: Steam the whole cauliflower for 8 minutes until just tender; dry it well.
Mix the yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, chilli, garam masala, turmeric and salt. Coat the cauliflower and rest for 15 minutes.
Roast at 200°C for 20 minutes, until browned at the edges.
Meanwhile, heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the blended tomato-onion with coriander powder for 10 minutes. Add ½ cup water.
Stir the mashed chickpeas into the gravy for extra protein.
Place the cauliflower in the gravy, spoon sauce over it, and finish with lemon juice and coriander.
note: A showpiece dish that needs only a teaspoon of oil; the whole head can be carved at the table.
